requirement.statement: The event-operations-lifecycle bundle SHALL execute a BO query, CancelEvent BO Action, independent BO Mutation, association Mutation, lifecycle Transition, constraint Validate, business-process composed operation, and CloseAndArchive extension Action; CancelEvent SHALL invoke its four registered children in order, root probes SHALL observe every affected entity, constraint violations SHALL be structured outcomes, and thrown business execution failures SHALL roll back and return diagnostics.

case.given: a cancellation case whose attendees are notified and whose event slot is reserved
case.then: four child refs are preserved, case and event writes commit, and before/after/diff expose both changes

case.given: a cancellation case whose attendees are not notified
case.then: query and validation children remain visible, no write commits, and a stable execution diagnostic identifies failure

case.given: association, publication lifecycle, refund settlement, and archive presets
case.then: real relational rows change with truthful mutation summaries and probes
both are successful structured outcomes whose valid field distinguishes business violation from execution failure
